WITH TT AS( SELECT LAG(VOLUME) OVER(ORDER BY NAME, CRE_DATE) AS VOL_PRE , CRE_DATE , NAME , FLOOR(MINUTE(CRE_DATE)/1) AS MMM , MAX(PRICE) PRICE , MAX(VOLUME) VOLUME FROM input_data2 WHERE CRE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL - 2 MINUTE) AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL + 2 MINUTE) AND CRE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_ADD(CRE_DATE, INTERVAL - 1 MINUTE) AND DATE_ADD(CRE_DATE, INTERVAL + 1 MINUTE) GROUP BY CRE_DATE , NAME ), TT2 AS ( SELECT * , ROUND(VOLUME, 2) AS TOTAL , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY CRE_DATE, TOTAL DESC) AS RN FROM TT WHERE VOLUME >= 10000000 )
